summary.text: William Buckbee (Billy Buckbee), a Republican, has represented Connecticut House District 67 since 2017.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he graduated from New Milford High School in 1989 and attended Western Connecticut State University, where he studied business and risk management.

Ballotpedia lists his work as executive director of New Milford's Harrybrooke Park, and says he has served as a Justice of the Peace for New Milford and on the town's Sewer Commission and Homeless Shelter Coalition.
